questions.stem: Zephyrwood uses 30 units of ceramic cookware per day and faces a 20-day supplier lead time with no safety stock. At what inventory level should it reorder?
questions.explanation: The reorder point without safety stock is daily demand multiplied by lead time in days: 30 units per day times 20 days equals 600 units. Ordering below that level risks running out before the new stock arrives.
questions.hint: Multiply daily usage by lead time in days.
